correctness.rationale: For R=M=V=F_2 and C={(0,0),(1,0)}, Hom_R(M,C) tensor_End(M) M -> C is the ordinary one-dimensional multiplication isomorphism; likewise V is M-static. f(a,0)=(a,a) is injective linear but sends the generator from weight 1 to weight 2. Binary monomial maps are coordinate permutations and preserve weight. This is a complete symbolic counterexample with n=2; the three possible nonzero images were also enumerated by inspected artifacts/verify.py. It does not disprove the later theorem as a statement, only its invocation of the false corollary.
